features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Prepare arcane spells from a spellbook and cast them using Intelligence.

features.name: Arcane Bond
features.summary: Choose a permanent bond with a familiar or a bonded object.

features.name: Familiar Choice
features.summary: If familiar was chosen for Arcane Bond, select the familiar creature and its master benefit.

features.name: Bonded Object Choice
features.summary: If bonded object was chosen for Arcane Bond, select the object's category.

features.name: Arcane School
features.summary: Choose one specialist school or study all magic as a universalist.

features.name: First Opposition School
features.summary: Specialist wizards choose a first school whose spells require two preparation slots.

features.name: Second Opposition School
features.summary: Specialist wizards choose a different second school whose spells require two preparation slots.

features.name: Cantrips
features.summary: Prepare 0-level wizard spells and cast prepared cantrips without expending them.

features.name: Scribe Scroll
features.summary: Gain Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat.

features.name: Spellbook
features.summary: Begin with all allowed cantrips, three chosen 1st-level spells, and additional 1st-level spells equal to Intelligence modifier; add two spells at every new wizard level.
features.scaling: two free spells per wizard level after 1st

features.name: Wizard Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose a metamagic feat, item creation feat, or Spell Mastery for which you qualify.

features.name: Wizard Bonus Feat
features.summary: Choose another metamagic feat, item creation feat, or Spell Mastery for which you qualify.
